features.name: Local-First IndexedDB Schema & Database Client
features.behavior: Dexie.js database client initialized with schemas for accounts, categories, transactions, offline_mutation_queue, conflict_audit_log, and settings.
features.evidence: All 9 unit tests passed in src/db/db.test.js (96ms), covering all 6 tables, primary keys, schema indexes, CRUD operations, and resetDatabase().

features.name: Monetary Precision & ISO 4217 Minor Units Engine
features.behavior: Converts currency strings to integer minor units (cents) and back via Intl.NumberFormat without floating-point errors.
features.evidence: All 34 unit tests passed in src/utils/currency.test.js (50ms), verifying zero floating-point accumulation (1.14 & 29.99), Arabic-Indic digits/delimiters, 0/2/3 decimal exponents (JPY, SAR, KWD), formatCurrency, formatCurrencyParts, parseAmountInput, and safe integer arithmetic.

features.name: Deterministic Category Pre-seeding
features.behavior: Pre-populates default expense and income categories with fixed system slugs (e.g. cat_food, cat_salary) to prevent duplication during cloud sync.
features.evidence: All 19 unit tests passed in src/services/category.test.js (145ms), verifying 16 deterministic default categories (10 expense, 6 income), cat_* system slugs, Arabic names and color tokens, idempotent pre-seeding, user_id isolation, type filtering, soft deletion, CategoryInUseError protection, and atomic transaction reassignment.

features.name: Account Management & Ledger-Backed Balance Service
features.behavior: Calculates account balances strictly from transaction ledger (initial_balance + incomes - expenses + net transfers) with cached performance reconciliation.
features.evidence: All 34 unit tests passed in src/services/account.test.js (378ms), verifying all 5 account types, initial_balance + inflows - outflows + transfersIn - transfersOut ledger formula, soft-deleted transaction exclusion, credit card liability semantics, balance drift detection & reconciliation, currency locking policy, transaction protection & atomic reassignment upon deletion, default account seeding, and financial position metrics.

features.name: Expense & Income Transaction CRUD
features.behavior: Records, edits, and soft-deletes (deleted_at) expense and income transactions, updating affected account balances atomically.
features.evidence: All 35 unit tests passed in src/services/transaction.test.js (633ms), verifying expense & income CRUD, integer minor units, atomic account balance adjustments, soft deletion & balance restoration, transaction restoration, multi-criteria filtering, search, pagination, and financial summary metrics.

features.name: Internal Account Transfer (Single-Record Model)
features.behavior: Executes transfers between accounts using a single transaction of type 'transfer' with source and destination account IDs, atomically updating both balances.
features.evidence: All 31 unit tests passed in src/services/transfer.test.js (425ms), verifying single-record transfer model, integer minor units, category_id null invariant, atomic source deduction & destination crediting, credit card debt settlement without cash flow distortion, transfer updates with 4-account reconciliation, soft deletion with atomic balance restoration, restoration guards against deleted accounts, search & multi-filtering, and offline mutation queue synchronization.

features.name: Credit Card Liability & Financial Position Metrics
features.behavior: Distinguishes between Available Funds, Credit Card Debt (Liabilities), Net Financial Position, and Period Cash Flow. Card payments reduce liability as transfers.
features.evidence: All 28 unit tests passed in src/services/financialMetrics.test.js (323ms), verifying distinction between Available Liquid Funds, Credit Card Debt (Liabilities), Overdraft Liabilities, Net Financial Position, Period Cash Flow (income, expenses, savings rate), Transfer Non-Distortion Invariant (transfers never alter income/expense/cash flow), Month-over-Month comparisons, Credit Card Liability summary, validated recordCreditCardPayment execution, and atomic dashboard overview metrics.

features.name: Arabic-First & RTL Design System Layout Shell
features.behavior: App shell rendering in RTL direction with IBM Plex Sans Arabic, CSS design tokens, bottom navigation for mobile, and right-aligned sidebar for desktop.
features.verification: npm run lint && npm run build
features.evidence: All checks passed: npm run lint with 0 errors, npm run build producing production bundle in 449ms, and 8 layout tests passing in src/components/layout/layout.test.js. Fully implements RTL-native layout, IBM Plex Sans Arabic font integration, CSS design tokens, 6 primary navigation hubs, responsive right-aligned desktop sidebar (260px), sticky header with breadcrumb and search trigger, mobile top bar, mobile bottom navigation bar (64px) with elevated center Quick Add FAB, sync status pill with 5 operational states, light/dark theme switching with localStorage persistence, and accessible Quick Add modal shell.

features.name: Quick Add Transaction Flow (<5s Target)
features.behavior: Fast transaction entry form requiring only amount and category, with auto-focused decimal keypad on mobile, today default date, last-used account, and non-destructive validation.
features.evidence: All 20 unit and integration tests passed in src/components/QuickAdd.test.jsx (607ms), verifying accessible dialog semantics (role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby), 3-mode segmented switcher (expense, income, transfer), amount input with decimal keypad and tabular numbers, today default date, last-used account persistence in localStorage, category chips filtering by mode, collapsible details (notes and tags), non-destructive validation preserving user inputs, error-state shake keyframes, concentric border-radius, scale(0.96) press feedback, and atomic Dexie database persistence with ledger balance recalculation.

features.name: Dashboard Financial Overview & Analytics Widgets
features.behavior: Renders KPI metrics, account balance cards, recent transactions, spending category breakdown chart, and cash flow trend chart using Recharts with accessible fallbacks.
features.verification: npm run lint && npm run build
features.evidence: All checks passed: npm run lint with 0 errors, npm run build producing production bundle in 2.98s, 7 backend analytics unit tests in src/services/dashboardAnalytics.test.js, and 13 integration tests in src/components/dashboard/Dashboard.test.jsx (total 252 automated tests passing across 13 test files). Fully implements 5 financial health KPI cards (Net Financial Position hero, Available Liquid Funds, Total Liabilities with credit card alerts, Month Expenses with MoM delta percentage pill, and Month Income with cash flow surplus), horizontally scrollable/grid account balance cards with ledger-calculated balances, Recharts Donut category spending breakdown chart with interactive central amount and accessible table fallback, Recharts Grouped Bar cash flow trend chart (weekly income vs expense) with accessible table fallback, recent transactions list widget with categorized vector icons and tabular numbers, welcoming FTUX quick add banner, and seamless real-time refresh upon transaction creation.

features.name: Transaction Ledger, Keyword Search & Multi-Filtering
features.behavior: Displays chronologically grouped transactions with real-time text search and multi-filtering by type, category, date range, account, and tags.
features.evidence: All 28 unit and integration tests passed in src/features/transactions/filter.test.js (305ms), and 9 integration tests passed in src/features/transactions/TransactionLedger.test.jsx (total 289 tests passing across 15 test suites). Fully implements chronological date grouping with daily subtotal headers ('اليوم', 'أمس', specific Arabic dates), real-time debounced text search with Arabic diacritic normalization (tashkeel, alef forms, taa marbuta), segmented type tabs (الكل, مصاريف, دخل, تحويلات), date range preset pills with custom date boundaries, filter drawer for multi-filtering by categories and accounts and amount ranges, active filters indicator badge and removable chips, filtered financial KPI summary banner (Total Expenses, Total Income, Net Cash Flow), accessible TransactionDetailModal, non-destructive TransactionEditModal, and soft-delete TransactionDeleteConfirmModal with automatic ledger-backed balance restoration.

features.name: Periodic Reports & Analytics View
features.behavior: Allows filtering by week, month, year, or custom date range, displaying category expenditure breakdown and ranked top expenses.
features.verification: npm run lint && npm run build
features.evidence: All checks passed: npm run lint with 0 errors, npm run build producing production bundle in 5.70s, 20 reports engine unit tests in src/features/reports/reportsAnalytics.test.js, and 11 integration tests in src/features/reports/ReportsView.test.jsx (total 320 automated tests passing across 17 test suites). Fully implements period presets (This Week, This Month, This Year, Custom Date Range), period navigation stepper with Arabic headlines, 5 period financial health KPI cards (Total Expense, Total Income, Net Cash Flow with surplus/deficit badge, Daily Average Spend, and Savings Rate %), Recharts Donut spending category breakdown chart with central overlay and interactive category drilldown pills, accessible sortable breakdown data table with proportional colored progress bars, Recharts Grouped Bar spending cadence trend chart (Income vs Expense) with accessible fallback, ranked top individual expenses list (#1, #2, ...) with rank badges and metadata, transaction detail modal inspection, non-destructive editing and deletion, welcoming empty state, and responsive RTL styling conforming to /impeccable, /ui-ux-pro-max, and /make-interfaces-feel-better.

features.name: Categories Management View
features.behavior: Allows viewing, adding, editing, and deleting custom categories with transaction reassignment guard preventing deletion of referenced categories.
features.evidence: All checks passed: npm run lint with 0 errors, npm run build producing production bundle in 4.16s, 16 unit tests in src/services/categoryGuard.test.js, and 12 component tests in src/features/categories/CategoriesView.test.jsx (total 348 automated tests passing across 19 test suites). Fully implements Categories Management View with sliding tabs (Expense vs Income), real-time search & scope filter pills (الكل, الافتراضية, المخصصة), 4 overview metric counters, CategoryCard with badge & transaction usage count, CategoryFormModal for create & edit with type selector, name validation, 18-icon picker, 16-color palette and real-time preview, and CategoryDeleteModal with CategoryInUse transaction reassignment guard preventing deletion of referenced categories and atomically reassigning transactions.

features.name: Currency Configuration & Immutability Lock
features.behavior: Allows selecting base currency on first run, locking currency selector once transactions or non-zero balances exist to prevent misleading numbers.

features.name: CSV Export Engine
features.behavior: Exports all transactions or filtered transactions to UTF-8 BOM CSV for Arabic spreadsheet compatibility.

features.name: Atomic JSON Backup & Restore Pipeline
features.behavior: Exports complete JSON backup; restores data atomically with schema validation, metadata preview, and pre-restore rollback snapshot.

features.name: Offline Mutation Queue & Concurrency Engine (OCC)
features.behavior: Queues offline CRUD operations sequentially with client_base_version; handles version-based conflict archiving into conflict_audit_log upon conflict.

features.name: Supabase Cloud Sync & Initial Account Merge
features.behavior: Integrates Supabase Auth; merges guest records idempotently without duplicating default categories by matching system slugs; pulls remote updates.

features.name: Fail-Safe Sign-Out with Un-Synced Mutation Blocking
features.behavior: Blocks sign-out and prompts user when pending offline mutations exist; purges local cloud cache only upon confirmed zero pending mutations.

features.name: PWA Offline Caching & Storage Persistence
features.behavior: Registers Service Worker for offline app shell caching and requests persistent storage quota via navigator.storage.persist().
